conditions: The standard's one-argument allocation form is used and p is the specified pointer variable access.
limitations: This concerns the one-argument new form. Variant-specific forms, disposal, availability of physical storage, and diagnostics have separate rules.
Exact unextended ISO/IEC 7185:1990 online replica. The replica gives the printed text precedence where they differ. ISO 10206 Extended Pascal and product dialects require separate evidence.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum, confirmed online-to-printed discrepancy, exact artifact drift, or contrary applicable evidence.

statement: The one-argument new(p) form in ISO/IEC 7185:1990 creates a totally undefined variable of the pointer type's domain. It creates a fresh identifying value for that variable and assigns it to p.
